ownerSnapshot: Explicit validated primitive copy, privately held; fresh copies returned for evidence only
samePrepareOwner: Strict equality of all ten fields; no JSON string object comparison or prototype method
key: JSON.stringify of the ten primitive tuple in this exact order; evidence binding, not authority
numberDomain: Safe nonnegative integers; native controller/session/surface/context nonzero. Window registration/activity/id predicate unchanged. Run nonempty string. Unknown/unrepresentable rejected.
staleScope: Old prepare/page owner or ticket discarded; callback checks actual window reference+generation and prepare/page/branch before actions and after native/window reads
sameOwnerReadiness: Parent observe/frame/check strict predicate still invalidates READY on snapshot/readiness/input/layout changes
preserved: reserveEnabled from the one real gate
witnessCore15: 1 if the reserve attempt belongs to a retired prepare/page, 0 if current; core1/2 remain the captured attempt scope
